# Agent Skills Setup (skills-repo)

> Offline, previewed, and rollback-safe migration of AI coding context (Skills, Rules, Instructions, and MCP configurations) across Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Cline, Windsurf, Copilot, and Gemini CLI.

## Overview
Agent Skills Setup solves AI developer lock-in. It allows developers to backup, synchronize, migrate, and audit their AI coding environment configurations (skills, cursorrules, system prompts, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and MCP configs) seamlessly between different AI IDEs and multiple workstations.

- **Category**: Developer Tools / AI Agent Migration / IDE Configuration Management
- **Author**: Luckycat133
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Luckycat133/skills-repo
- **License**: MIT
- **Supported IDEs**: Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Cline, Roo Code, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw
- **Current Version**: 0.10.2

## Key Capabilities
1. **Cross-IDE Context Translation**:
   - Automatically translates `.cursorrules` ↔ `CLAUDE.md` ↔ `AGENTS.md` ↔ `.windsurfrules` ↔ `copilot-instructions.md`.
2. **MCP Configuration Synchronizer**:
   - Harmonizes MCP server declarations between Cursor (`mcp.json`), Claude Desktop (`claude_desktop_config.json`), Claude Code (`settings.json`), and Antigravity.
3. **Secret Redaction & Safe Backup (ACB Bundles)**:
   - Sanitizes API keys, secrets, and environment tokens before bundling.
   - Generates deterministic, previewed diffs with instant 1-click rollback safety.
4. **Offline & Hermetic**:
   - Zero external cloud dependencies; runs 100% locally on your machine.

## Installation & Usage

### Via OpenClaw / ClawHub
```bash
openclaw skills install @luckycat133/agent-skills-setup
```

### Via Direct Git Clone
```bash
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/Luckycat133/skills-repo.git
```

### Common Agent Prompts (Say this to your AI):
- *"Migrate Skills, rules, and MCP configurations from Cursor in this project to Claude Code."*
- *"Back up all portable AI coding setup from my installed IDEs to an ACB bundle."*
- *"Restore this ACB bundle to the installed IDEs on my new computer."*

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### How does Agent Skills Setup prevent leaking private API keys during migration?
The built-in detector scans for high-entropy tokens, environment variables (`*_KEY`, `*_SECRET`), and bearer tokens, automatically redacting them into placeholder values in the portable ACB bundle.

### Does migration overwrite existing IDE configurations without warning?
No. Every migration operation generates a unified preview diff (`migration-plan.md`) requiring explicit user approval before files are touched, and keeps automated backup checkpoints for rollback.
